fusions.name: Three-Shell Toss
fusions.desc: Throws 3 weights at once, spread apart, each dealing 9 damage and knocking what it hits back 2.5 tiles. Each hit has a 30% chance to turn the target against its allies for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Blindside
fusions.desc: A blow that deals 34 damage, always lands as a critical hit and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Your movement speed rises 25% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Deadfall
fusions.desc: Sets a deadfall on the nearest enemy that waits 20 seconds; the first enemy to come within 3 tiles of it is crushed, and it deals 20 damage in a blast around it.

fusions.name: Opening Exploited
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
